Records the consecration of the images of the god Vidyāśaṅkarēśvara and the goddess Nagaripuri Durgābhavāni, the family deity of the Dēvarakōta chiefs, on the bank of the Śivagaṅga by Rājā Yērlagaḍḍa Aṅkinēḍu-Bahadaru. The ceremony was performed by Abhinavōddaṇḍa Śaṅkara Bhāratīsvāmi.Read more (1 KB)
